reviews.comment: For his Biodiv class, not the 305. Dr. Oswald is a great systematist, but as a professor he is horrid. The textbook is outdated, and so he teaches you wrong. His grading makes no sense as he takes majority points off instead of giving them for essay questions. He also provides horrible specimens for exams while expecting you to submit high quality.

Oswald single-handedly got me to change majors. This class is difficult to begin with then half of what he says is "definitely going to be on the exam" isn't there and things he spends less than a minute on in lecture are worth a lot of the exam grades. All open ended questions. I'd say take a diff prof but he's the only one that teaches ENTO305.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Prof Oswald isn't such a bad guy as some other students may make him out to be. I understand that the evolution of insect structures is something he is very passionate about, so he expects you to be just as engaged as himself. The tests are unbearable but are more realistic to the higher-level entomology classes. STUDY STUDY STUDY.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy
